Would you like to save the last photo
to your SD Card?

Your photo has been saved in
the Nintendo 3DS Camera application!

If you don’t save your photo, it will disappear.
Are you sure that’s all right?

Now saving your photo. Do not turn off
the power or remove the SD Card.

Your photo was saved in the
Nintendo 3DS Camera application!
Warning!
Due to its size, the saved photo cannot be
sent to the Pokémon Global Link.

The photo could not be saved due to
the lack of space on your SD Card.

The Nintendo 3DS Camera application has no
room for additional photos, so your photo
cannot be saved.

Your saved data has been deleted due to
errors detected in the files on your SD Card.
Saving the photo failed.
